deadline_wording: For best consideration, you should complete and submit the FAFSA to the federal student aid application system as soon as possible after the application becomes available. IT IS IMPORTANT TO APPLY EARLY.
notes: No published date. OTAG is awarded until funds run out; the page says how early a student applies may decide the award. Wording is not year-specific and applies to 2027-28 as well.
source_name: Oklahoma State Regents for Higher Education (OKcollegeStart)

deadline_wording: Application Deadlines: June 30 - 8th-11th graders (recommended deadline); Dec. 31 - 12th graders (electronic submission or postmark required). All applications must be received prior to the student's official date of high school graduation.
notes: Separate state application, NOT the FAFSA. Recurring annual dates printed without a year, so no ISO date is given here. FAFSA is used later for income verification.
source_name: Oklahoma State Regents for Higher Education

deadline_wording: Submit a FAFSA or ORSAA as soon as possible after October 1 each year ... Awards are first-come, first-served until funds are depleted.

deadline_wording: The Oregon Promise Grant has rolling deadlines based on when the student graduates ... Students who graduate between July 1, 2026 and June 30, 2027 can start applying in October 2026.
notes: Deadline varies by high school graduation date; OSAC publishes a "Find Your Deadline" chart. Application for students who graduated before 30 June 2026 is CLOSED as of the check date.

notes: No statewide FAFSA date. CHE: "To apply, students must complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA). program_name: South Dakota state aid (no FAFSA-dated program)
notes: No state-set FAFSA deadline found. The state site says only: "Students are encouraged to complete the FAFSA as soon as possible after it becomes available ... Many colleges have priority deadlines." The state links to a per-college list (Mapping Your Future) with dates from Jan 1 to Apr 20. SD merit programs (Opportunity/Freedom Scholarship, Dakota Corps) do not turn on a state FAFSA date.
source_name: SD Board of Regents / Our Dakota Dreams

deadline_wording: Colleges often have priority deadlines for the FAFSA ... Below is a list of South Dakota colleges and universities with their priority FAFSA deadlines.
notes: Examples on the list: Augustana 1 Mar, DSU 1 Mar, NSU 1 Mar, SDSU 1 Mar, USD 1 Apr, Lake Area Tech 1 Apr, Western Dakota Tech 20 Apr, U of Sioux Falls 1 Jan. List page dated 19 Dec 2025.
source_name: Mapping Your Future (linked from the SD state site)

program_name: TEXAS Grant and other state financial aid (state priority deadline)
notes: THECB FY2027 State Financial Aid Guidelines (as of 7/14/2026), TAC 22.6: "General Academic Teaching Institutions (GATIs) in Texas ... must publicize and use January 15 as the state priority application deadline." Guidelines print no calendar year; FY2027 = academic year 2026-27, so the date fell on 15 Jan 2026 and has passed. Applies to FAFSA and TASFA alike.

program_name: TEXAS Grant and other state financial aid (state priority deadline)
notes: Derived by applying the standing TAC 22.6 January 15 rule to the 2027-28 cycle. Confirm against the FY2028 guidelines when published.
